correctness.rationale: Strong convexity and KKT give a continuous piecewise-affine proximal map. Every row subset is realized with strict complementarity because D is surjective. Constant-preserving local Jacobians yield exact single-cut BV induced norms. An exhaustive fraction-arithmetic enumeration checks every face and cut at n=2..8; n=4 has an explicit finite primal-dual witness. The global lower bound and asymptotic liminf follow analytically from the affine projector slope formula. No extrapolation from finite code is needed.

value.rationale: A standard robust trend filter has Euclidean proximal nonexpansivity but its two-input path-variation sensitivity was not quantified in the closest papers. The exact first instability size, tuning invariance, complete small-sample constants, and persistent all-length lower bound give a natural stability boundary relevant to BV-noise control and distinguish the ℓ1 penalty from quadratic smoothing.
